passages.text: Belgium needs two hreflang codes: nl-BE for Flemish and fr-BE for Wallonia French. Never reuse nl-NL for Belgian Dutch, as vocabulary and cultural context differ. Regional sensitivities make correct language targeting important for trust and rankings.
